title: alter table tablename engine=innodb cause data loss
review_reason: Original case needs external mysql_random_data_load with unspecified seed/version and repeated purge/online DDL race. Later deterministic 1000-row variant explicitly adds sleep instrumentation to two source locations. Existing release SQL alone cannot establish required race occurrence; need instrumented isolated build or controlled schedule, and record identity/count rather than count drift alone.
